description: This file contains the implementation of a custom operator called MaskedSelectOperator for the torchfuzz framework. It defines the operator's properties, input specification generation, and code generation for the masked_select operation in PyTorch.

classes.name: MaskedSelectOperator
classes.description: A class representing the masked_select operator, capable of generating input specifications and code snippets for the operation.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the MaskedSelectOperator instance with the operator name 'masked_select'.

methods.name: str|None torch_op_name(self)
methods.description: Returns the name of the corresponding PyTorch operation, 'torch.masked_select'.

methods.name: bool can_produce(self, output_spec: Spec)
methods.description: Checks if this operator can produce the given output specification; specifically, it returns True if the output is a 1D tensor.

methods.name: list[Spec] fuzz_inputs_specs(self, output_spec: Spec, num_inputs: int = 2)
methods.description: Generates input tensor and mask specifications suitable for the masked_select operation given the desired output spec.

methods.name: str codegen( self, output_name: str, input_names: list[str], output_spec: Spec )
methods.description: Generates the code for performing masked_select on synthesized inputs that match the output specification.

ctags.name: codegen
ctags.signature: ( self, output_name: str, input_names: list[str], output_spec: Spec )

ctags.name: fuzz_inputs_specs
ctags.pattern: /^    def fuzz_inputs_specs(self, output_spec: Spec, num_inputs: int = 2) -> list[Spec]:$/
